findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
findings.description: Forces all connections to use HTTPS
findings.risk: Attackers can intercept unencrypted HTTP traffic

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.description: Prevents the page from being embedded in iframes
findings.risk: Clickjacking attacks can trick users into clicking malicious content

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: Prevents browsers from guessing the content type
findings.risk: Browsers may execute malicious files disguised as safe content

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Controls which resources the browser is allowed to load
findings.risk: Cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks can steal user data

findings.title: Missing X-XSS-Protection
findings.description: Enables the browser built-in XSS filter
findings.risk: No browser-level protection against reflected XSS attacks

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Controls how much referrer information is shared
findings.risk: Sensitive URLs and user data may leak to third-party sites

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Controls which browser features the site can use
findings.risk: Site may access camera, microphone, or location without restriction
